topDirectories.name: cmd/gowatch
topDirectories.description: Application entry point: flags, config loading, theme and keymap resolution, collector setup, optional OTLP receiver and the dashboard

topDirectories.name: internal/docker
topDirectories.description: Docker daemon interaction: container watching, stats and logs collection, collector options and the global alert engine, trace store and AWS manager

topDirectories.name: internal/ui
topDirectories.description: Terminal UI using tcell/tview: dashboard, themes, panel layout, themed texts, configurable keybindings (keymap, input handling), the interactive help page, the AWS view and the JSON log export

topDirectories.name: internal/config
topDirectories.description: YAML configuration: types and defaults, layered loading, validation, untrusted-layer rules, alert rule overrides and the example file. A leaf package (no docker, ui or filter imports)

topDirectories.name: internal/alert
topDirectories.description: Alerting engine: rules, hysteresis, consecutive-hit counters and alert lifecycle

topDirectories.name: internal/filter
topDirectories.description: Container search and filter state (name, ID, image, status, labels, minimum log level)

topDirectories.name: internal/trace
topDirectories.description: Distributed tracing: trace store, log correlator, OTLP/HTTP receiver and exporter

topDirectories.name: internal/aws
topDirectories.description: AWS client built on aws-sdk-go-v2: settings and enablement, error classification, state and manager, SSO token handling, and a poller that resolves the credentials, reads the identity of the active credentials and lists the accounts of its SSO login. CloudWatch Logs are not read yet

components.name: Docker Collector
components.description: Watches Docker containers, collects stats and logs via Moby client; Configure() sets the log tail, history size, alert rules and AWS options

components.name: Docker Parser
components.description: Parses Docker stats and multiplexed log streams

components.name: Dashboard
components.description: Interactive terminal dashboard with services table, resources panel, logs view, alerts modal and the help page

components.name: Theme
components.description: Color roles, the four built-in themes (dark, light, solarized, nord), per-role overrides and tview tag/style helpers

components.name: Layout
components.description: Builds the main grid from the layout config: panel order, hidden panels, relative heights and the focus fallback

components.name: Keymap
components.description: Keyboard actions with their groups and descriptions, key parsing, the default and vim presets, BuildKeymap with the keybindings overrides and Keymap.Lookup

components.name: Input
components.description: Application-wide key handling: handleInput (the search field guard, the help page, the keymap lookup) and runAction

components.name: Help page
components.description: The interactive help page opened with ?: a table of the active keymap grouped by section, drawn on top of the other pages

components.name: Texts
components.description: Themed texts built from the keymap: the help bar, the alerts modal title, the Docker-offline bar and page

components.name: Configuration
components.description: Config types and built-in defaults; Load layers ~/.gowatch/config.yaml and ./gowatch.yaml (or one --config file), Validate checks the values and DefaultYAML prints the commented example

components.name: Alert Engine
components.description: Evaluates the alert rules for every container on each refresh

components.name: Filter
components.description: Filter state and the function that applies it to the containers

components.name: OTLP Receiver
components.description: OTLP/HTTP JSON trace receiver (started by main when enabled) and the trace exporter (nothing outside the tests calls it)

components.name: AWS Client Manager
components.description: AWS state and options (AWS_* environment variables take priority over the config file); the manager resolves its settings without any AWS call, a poller goroutine started by main resolves the credentials, reads the identity of the active credentials and lists the accounts of its SSO login, and GetState() returns a copy of the snapshot

components.name: Main
components.description: Application entry point - parses flags, loads the config, resolves the theme and the keymap, configures the collector, starts the AWS poller and the optional OTLP receiver, creates the Docker client and runs the dashboard

dataFlow.description: main.go parses the flags and calls config.Load(); a config error is printed to stderr and the process exits before the TUI opens
main.go resolves the theme with ui.ResolveTheme() (the --theme flag replaces theme.name) and builds the keymap with ui.BuildKeymap(); an invalid theme, color, preset, action or key is a startup error

main.go creates the Docker client via client.New(client.FromEnv), calls docker.Configure() with the log tail, history size, alert rules and AWS options, and starts the AWS poller (it returns at once and does nothing unless AWS is enabled)
If tracing.otlp_receiver.enabled is set, main.go starts the OTLP receiver on docker.GetGlobalTraceStore(); a bind failure is fatal
main.go creates the dashboard with ui.NewDashboardWithOptions() (theme, keymap, layout) and applies the initial filters
A goroutine ticker (refresh_interval, 2s by default) calls docker.WatchContainers()

The collector lists containers, fetches stats and logs for each, correlates traces from the log lines, evaluates the alert rules and copies the AWS state (the identity row, and the rows of the SSO login, once the AWS poller has connected)
The parsed data goes to Dashboard.Update(), which applies the filters and renders the services table, resources panel, logs view and alerts list (hidden panels are skipped)

Keys go through Dashboard.handleInput: the search field gets every key while it has focus, otherwise the keymap gives an action that runAction performs (the help page is the exception: while it is open only closing and scrolling work)
